title: BlackboardSynthesis
description: A SYNTHESIS entry: the swarm's consolidated answer for the task, with full lineage. supporting_entry_ids[] points to the analyses/observations it consolidates. held_out[] preserves items deliberately NOT folded into the answer (minority findings, rejected candidates, low-confidence observations) so the winner always carries lineage to the losers — omitted is never deleted (lossless distillation law). source_handles[] preserves the upstream provenance handles end-to-end. serves_truth is pinned const false — even the final synthesis is a CANDIDATE answer, never served truth; Baltor governs whether it (or any part) is promoted.

entry_id.description: id of the BlackboardEntry (kind=synthesis) this body belongs to

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this synthesis belongs to

answer.description: the consolidated candidate answer for the task

supporting_entry_ids.description: entry_ids of the analyses/observations this answer consolidates (lineage)

held_out.description: entry_ids/handles deliberately NOT folded into the answer (minority/rejected/low-confidence) — preserved so the winner has lineage to the losers; omitted != deleted

source_handles.description: upstream provenance handles (ctx:// or doc#section) carried end-to-end so the answer is never sourceless

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — even the final synthesis is a candidate answer, never served truth; promotion is a separate Baltor-governed decision
